decisions.reason: Requesting an updated BOM does not necessarily change the CAD requirement, whose state already accounts for the revised motor selection.
The source requests a revised BOM but does not require any change to the basic wiring-plan deliverable.
The BOM revision does not change the approved dispensing mechanism, sequence, flow, or other controlled-dispensing behavior.
The source does not modify the leak-prevention or sealing requirements.
Updating the BOM artifact to reflect prior component selections does not establish a new mixing, frothing, whisk, or positioning requirement.
A revised BOM does not alter the existing strategy of using off-the-shelf prototype electronics.
The source does not change whisk removability, detachment, tool use, or removal purposes.
The updated-BOM request does not modify bowl removal, swapping, or clearance behavior.
The source does not change the prototype's approved 120V wall-power requirement.
